integrity: Universal analytic proof. No finite experiment is used as proof. The \(q=\infty\) endpoint is already implied by the lead source; the new content is the sharp finite-\(q\) cross-norm profile and the single structural proof for all \(q\).
scientific_limitations: Specific to dimension two and cube-bounded inputs. It does not determine finite-\(p\) planar constants or higher-dimensional cube constants; an unindexed historical cross-norm formulation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact planar cube-to-\(\ell_q\) prefix constant under signed coordinate permutations
